verdict.rationale: HubSpot offers a documented MCP server giving AI agents read/write access to deals and engagements, plus REST APIs for deal/custom object updates and native 'smart deal progression' that updates CRM and next steps after calls/meetings. However, the specific workflow of an agent parsing email/meeting signals via MCP to update deal stage and next steps isn't demonstrated end-to-end, and the built-in 'smart deal progression' is a HubSpot-native AI feature rather than an example of an external agent doing this via API/MCP.
